comparison.objective: Unnest and distribute six traffic cones evenly along a curved road; candidate finishes four inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Top-edge grasping, nested-object separation, transport, and repeated upright placement versus recessed coaxial alignment, bimanual impact, and millimetre-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Six released upright cones within centerline, endpoint, and spacing tolerances versus four contained fractures with no coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Repeated spatial distribution and unnesting do not test the candidate's impact-fracture mechanism.
